# Amit Kuzi

Software Architect & Engineering Consultant based in Holon, Israel. Building software since 1997.
This host (amitkuzi.github.io) carries the working artifacts — live tools, source repositories and
published 3D models. The writing, case studies and contact details live at https://amitkuzi.com

The canonical entity record is https://amitkuzi.com/#amit-kuzi — every schema block on this host
points there rather than declaring a competing identity.

## Live tools

- **OneWall** — https://amitkuzi.github.io/OneWall/ — browser-based parametric customizer for
  vase-mode bins/containers and Gridfinity bins and baseplates. OpenSCAD model re-implemented in
  JavaScript, Three.js preview, client-side CSG, export to STL / STEP / 3MF.
  Docs: https://amitkuzi.github.io/OneWall/about.html · Source: https://github.com/amitkuzi/OneWall
- **localViewer** — https://amitkuzi.github.io/localViewer/ — local-first viewer for Markdown,
  YAML, CSV, STL, 3MF, STEP, OpenSCAD and images. Files are parsed in the browser and never
  uploaded. PWA, works offline. Source: https://github.com/amitkuzi/localViewer
